data.one_liner: Web implementation of image_picker that lets users select images or videos via the browser file picker.
data.what_it_does: Provides the same API as the image_picker package for the web platform. It returns XFile objects that contain Blob URLs or byte data. Supports image and video selection with optional resize/quality parameters where applicable.
use_when: You need to pick images or videos on Flutter web using the familiar image_picker API.
You want a single package that works across mobile and web without extra code.
avoid_when: You require precise control over image resizing for GIFs or need maxDuration for video capture.
You need guaranteed capture behavior across all browsers.
strengths: Handles XFile abstraction and Blob URLs automatically
Supports multi‑video selection and recent browser features
weaknesses: Resize/quality options limited for GIFs and only affect JPG/WEBP
maxDuration not supported for videos on web
Behavior depends on browser support for input attributes

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core package that works on mobile; uses this plugin automatically for web.
